categories.main_business_segments: Jiyuan Packaging Holdings Limited primarily operates in the metal packaging industry, focusing on the production, printing, and sales of three-piece tinplate cans and two-piece aluminum cans. The company also provides metal packaging materials and related processing services, including tinplate printing and coating. Its product applications cover beverages, food packaging, and other consumer goods.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced equipment imported from Europe, the US, and Japan for automated, high-speed production lines. Key technologies include mold design and development, process optimization, material thinning, and inline quality inspection systems. It holds multiple patents and certifications such as ISO9001, ISO14001, and FSSC22000, emphasizing continuous R&D in process improvement, new can shapes, and coating technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jiyuan serves major beverage and food manufacturers, including leading brands in China’s soft drink, beer, and dairy sectors. Its products are used for packaging carbonated drinks, beer, teas, juices, canned foods, and powdered milk. The company maintains long-term strategic partnerships with core customers like Yinlu Group and other prominent beverage producers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main production and sales operations are concentrated in China, with manufacturing facilities in Fujian, Hubei, Guangdong, and Anhui provinces. It also has subsidiaries registered in the Cayman Islands, Taiwan, and Samoa, with Taiwan serving as a management and liaison office. Sales are predominantly within the Chinese mainland market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiyuan operates in the midstream segment of the metal packaging supply chain, manufacturing metal cans and related packaging materials. It sources raw materials such as tinplate and aluminum coils from upstream suppliers and supplies finished packaging products to downstream beverage and food manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes process refinement, production cost reduction, and new product development, including special-shaped cans and thinner materials. It aims to expand two-piece aluminum can production capacity and develop new markets such as beverage filling and export. R&D efforts focus on equipment upgrades, coating technologies, and mold innovations to enhance product competitiveness and meet evolving customer needs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of metal packaging containers, including three-piece tinplate cans and two-piece aluminum cans. The company also earns income from printing and coating services related to metal packaging. Sales are conducted mainly on a contract and order basis with large beverage and food manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiyuan is positioned as a leading metal packaging manufacturer in China, competing with large industry players such as COFCO Packaging, Orijin, and Shengxing Group. It leverages its production footprint, strategic customer relationships, and technological capabilities to maintain a competitive edge in a market characterized by consolidation and scale economies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jiyuan reported revenues of approximately NT$3.32 billion, a 13.3% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss of NT$28.6 million, showing improvement from prior losses. The company has a stable asset base exceeding NT$5.5 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D. Despite short-term challenges, it expects steady growth driven by market demand and operational efficiencies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiyuan emphasizes high-quality, reliable metal packaging with superior sealing, durability, and environmental compliance. Its competitive advantages include advanced automated production lines, patented technologies, comprehensive quality control systems, and close proximity to major customers enabling timely delivery and cost savings. The company also focuses on innovation in can design and material efficiency to meet customer customization and sustainability requirements.
